annotations.title: Create a paused lead or message campaign

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Creates a Meta Instant Form lead campaign (goal lead_generation, the ad set's leadGenFormId from ads_lead_forms_list, placements without Audience Network, the age range and countries in targeting) with one image ad, created PAUSED. It lands in the owner's Proposed campaigns and never runs or spends until the owner approves it (ads_campaign_approve). headline, body, imageUrl or creativeId and budget (dollars; budgetType daily or lifetime) are required; promotedObject.pageId picks the Facebook Page. goal messages instead creates a click-to-message ad (Messenger + Instagram Direct, imageUrl only, no form): the brand's automatic first reply greets people with quick replies tagged with armKey, and each conversation lands as a lead with its ad/arm attribution; also PAUSED and proposed. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns.)

adAccountId.description: Default: the brand's selected ad account; must match it.

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

armKey.description: messages only: the test arm in each quick-reply payload and lead (default: from the headline).

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

callToAction.description: A CTA from the ads create config (default: the owner's default, e.g. LEARN_MORE; SIGN_UP suits a lead form).

creativeId.description: lead_generation only: a saved ad creative id instead of imageUrl.

goal.description: lead_generation (Instant Form) or messages (click-to-message, Messenger + Instagram Direct).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key return the first result instead of creating twice.

imageUrl.description: The ad image (an allowed host). Or send creativeId.

leadGenFormId.description: lead_generation only, and required there: an Instant Form id (GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms).

placements.description: Default automatic = Facebook, Instagram and Messenger (no Audience Network).

promotedObject.description: The Facebook Page the lead ad runs from.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

schedule.description: ISO dates; default now to +7 days.

targeting.description: Age range 13-65 and the usual targeting fields.

name: ads_campaign_create
